data.name: Trash Party
data.detailed_description:
Cleaning day never goes as planned

Trash Party is an online co-op party game for up to four players. You and your friends are the garbage crew of a bright cartoon city, and the truck is yours. Whoever reaches it first takes the wheel; everyone else collects, throws, and hangs off the back for a ride.

One truck, four people, zero coordination

The truck starts parked on the street and goes wherever the driver decides. No fixed route, no timed stops. Collectors sprint between piles, grab bags and hurl them at the truck while it is still moving. Time your jump wrong and traffic flattens you: cartoon slapstick, no blood, back on your feet in a second.

Sort it right, buy more time

Every bag belongs somewhere. The truck carries three compartments, recyclable, organic and glass, and hitting the right one pays full points and adds seconds to the level clock. Heavy trash buys more time. Bulky junk like sofas, fridges, tires and mattresses does not fit: run it through the crusher first and it comes out as a compact cube in the right color, ready to throw.

Clean the city, earn your stars

Collection zones are marked on the minimap and disappear once they are cleared, and a clean zone stays clean. The level ends when the whole city is spotless, and how fast your crew did it turns into stars. Stars unlock new levels on the world map hub, so the crew keeps rolling to the next neighborhood.

Features

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players, with invite-code rooms
  • Playable solo if you would rather run the route on your own
  • A garbage truck anyone can drive and a rear bumper anyone can hang from
  • Cartoon physics: thrown bags, flailing arms, weight that slows you down, comedic knockdowns
  • Waste sorting into recyclable, organic and glass, plus a crusher for bulky items
  • A world map hub with levels unlocked by stars
  • Colorful low-poly 3D with cel shading

data.short_description: Online co-op party game for up to 4 players. Drive a garbage truck through a colorful cartoon city, hang off the back, and sort recyclable, organic and glass into the right compartment. The faster your crew cleans every block, the more stars you earn.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required for online co-op.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required for online co-op.
